# Kaye Putnam

> Kaye Putnam is a brand strategist and marketing leader working at the intersection of psychology, positioning, and AI. Over 20 years she has helped 100+ brands find their voice, built the brand archetype quiz taken by 250,000+ people, and now builds AI-powered marketing systems. Based in the US.

## Start here

- [Home](https://kayeputnam.com/): who Kaye is and what she does
- [About](https://kayeputnam.com/about): backstory, approach, and current work
- [Work](https://kayeputnam.com/work): selected case studies
- [Contact](https://kayeputnam.com/contact): brand strategy, speaking, and collaboration inquiries

## Case studies

- [Freewyld Foundry](https://kayeputnam.com/work/freewyld-foundry): brand and marketing systems for a short-term-rental management company
- [Freewyld Cabins](https://kayeputnam.com/work/freewyld-cabins): hospitality brand for a cabin collection
- [The Brand Studio](https://kayeputnam.com/work/the-brand-studio): brand strategy for 100+ client brands
- [The Brand Archetype Quiz](https://kayeputnam.com/work/brand-archetype-quiz): quiz product with 250K+ takers, rebuilt natively
